name: mstack-antigravity-led-dev
description: Antigravity coordinator workflow where another installed vendor offered by mstack-vendors (claude or codex) writes each phase of a plan folder, a list of issues, or one larger task while Antigravity briefs it, runs validation, reviews every phase (plus an optional third-vendor reviewer), processes findings with mstack-receive-review, and commits only the exact accepted tree. Runs in Antigravity only.
